title: Data Analyst - Asset Management
text: Data Analyst - Asset Management at Ajilon (Sydney, North Shore & Northern Beaches; Contract/Temp; salary: not stated). Scope of the position: Interpret, translate and contextualise business and data requirements with key stakeholders involved in the asset and facilities life cycle management Prepare, validate and load asset specific data sets into the client AFM Information system using the agreed formats and units of measure Contribute to the development and upkeep of the client asset classification and specification library Identify program delivery issues and risks, assist with mitigation strategies, and escalate where necessary Support continuous improvement in data manipulation, process optimisation and quality assurance through communicating the asset information gaps with stakeholders The ideal candidate will have; Stakeholder engagement - demonstrated ability to bridge the gap between business and technical teams Data Analysis - experience looking into large amounts of data to analyse, map, and assess for impacts Proven skills in ETL techniques with ability to work with MS Excel and IBM Tririga or similar AFM system If you are interested in exploring the same please "APPLY NOW" or share your profile with Kirti at Kirti.Sikarwar@Ajilon.com.au
